title: A background landing that pushed never closes its window when land left the session's checkout un-fast-forwarded
goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-cwoyc7yh: ql_capture.settle_pending reads only the item file in the checkout at the event's cwd, which holds the done status only when bl_land.fast_forward_start moved it; a checkout that is detached, on a branch whose upstream is not origin/main, dirty, or diverged keeps the file at doing, so the done-pending row never settles and every later prompt of the session counts on the item's window. settle_pending also settles a pending item whose done status is on the integration main (origin/main) though the checkout lags, the repro exits 0, and querylog.md and usage.md say so.

run: import os,sys,json,subprocess,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());co=t/'co';co.mkdir();g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(co),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();g('init','-q','-b','main');g('config','user.email','a@example.com');g('config','user.name','a');f=co/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog'/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.parent.mkdir(parents=True);w=lambda s:(f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':s})),g('add','-A'),g('commit','-qm',s));w('doing');c1=g('rev-parse','HEAD');w('done');g('update-ref','refs/remotes/origin/main','HEAD');g('reset','-q','--hard',c1);os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;q.record('prompt','s1',prompt_id='p1',prompt='x');q.record('work','s1',prompt_id='p1',action='done-pending',item='ST-aaaaaaaa');r=q.settle_pending(Path(q.spool_dir()),'s1',{'cwd':str(co)},'p2');print('done rows after a landing pushed to origin/main while the checkout was not fast-forwarded:',r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)
